_comment: Copy to scripts/fetch_results.config.json (gitignored) and fill in. That file names the node and your account, so it stays out of this public repo.
_identity_file: Optional. Omit to use the key already loaded in the Windows ssh-agent, which is the normal case. Give a path only if you want a specific key file.
_alerts: Lines matching these patterns in ~/chain.log or <repo>/logs/run_matrix.log raise an [ALERT] in logs/fetch.log and a desktop pop-up. Each distinct line alerts once, never again. Omit the block to use these defaults. ignore_case=false keeps the all-caps markers from matching ordinary prose.
_min_age_minutes: A remote results.json is fetched only once it carries run_matrix.py's power record and has not changed for this many minutes (default 15, longer than run_matrix's 10-minute finish grace).
_milestones: Optional. When scripts/block_report.py reports <block> newly complete with exactly <runs> runs, the pop-up shows <message> and fetch.log gets <commands> -- but only if the node's run_matrix.log matches require_log_regex (a clean end); otherwise the pop-up says it did NOT end cleanly. Every other newly complete block raises a generic pop-up.

milestones.require_log_regex: block finished: <N> ok, 0 failed, 0 not attempted

_python: Interpreter used for the block report. The CPU venv is the right one; it only runs analyze_results.py and export_latex_tables.py.
